title: Set 267

sentences.ko: 그 에어프라이어 괜히 샀어. 일주일에 한 번 쓸까 말까 한데 조리대를 통째로 차지해서, 이제 커피 머신 둘 데가 없어.
sentences.text: I really shouldn't have bought that air fryer. I use it like once a week, and it takes up the whole counter, so now I don't have anywhere to put the coffee maker.

alts.text: Ugh, buying that air fryer was a mistake. I use it maybe once a week, and it hogs the whole counter, so now there's nowhere for the coffee maker to go.
I truly should not have purchased that air fryer. I use it approximately once a week, and it occupies the entire counter, so I now have nowhere to put the coffee maker.

sentences.note: **shouldn't have bought** 는 사지 말았어야 했다는 뜻으로, 이미 한 일을 후회할 때 씁니다. **takes up** 은 자리를 차지한다는 말이고, casual 의 **hogs** 는 혼자 독차지한다는 느낌입니다.

sentences.ko: 추수감사절에 이모네 갔는데, 들어가자마자 다들 나 언제 결혼하냐고 묻는 거야. 사귀는 사람도 없다고 했더니 어째 더 난리가 났어.
sentences.text: I went to my aunt's for Thanksgiving, and the second I walked in, everybody wanted to know when I'm getting married. I said I'm not even seeing anyone, and somehow that made it worse.

alts.text: So I was at my aunt's for Thanksgiving, and the minute I got there, everyone's asking when I'm getting married. I told them I'm not even dating anybody, and somehow that just made it worse.

I visited my aunt for Thanksgiving, and as soon as I arrived, everyone wanted to know when I would be getting married. I explained that I am not currently seeing anyone, and somehow that only made matters worse.

sentences.note: **the second I walked in** 은 들어서자마자라는 뜻입니다. **seeing anyone** 은 누군가와 사귀고 있다는 말이고, **made it worse** 는 일을 더 키웠다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 회사에 이메일마다 전체 답장 누르는 사람이 있어. 그냥 고맙다는 말 한마디여도 그래. 나도 웬만하면 신경 안 쓰겠는데, 그런 게 하루에 마흔 통쯤 와서 정작 중요한 메일을 자꾸 놓쳐.
sentences.text: There's this guy at work who hits reply all on every single email, even when he's just saying thanks. I wouldn't care so much, but I get like forty of those a day, and I keep missing the stuff that actually matters.

alts.text: This one guy at work hits reply all on literally every email, even if it's just thanks. Wouldn't bug me that much, but I get like forty a day, and I keep missing the stuff that's actually important.

There is a colleague of mine who uses reply all on every email, even when he is simply expressing thanks. I would not mind so much, but I receive approximately forty of those messages a day, and I continue to overlook the ones that are genuinely important.

sentences.note: **reply all** 은 전체 답장입니다. **I wouldn't care so much, but** 은 웬만하면 넘어가겠는데 문제는 이렇다며 불만을 꺼낼 때 씁니다. **the stuff that actually matters** 는 정작 중요한 것들이라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 내 폰이 자꾸 저절로 소리를 끝까지 줄여. 주머니 속에서 내가 버튼을 누르는 줄 알았는데, 어젯밤에 탁자 위에 그냥 놓여 있는데도 또 그러더라.
sentences.text: My phone keeps turning the volume all the way down on its own. I thought I was hitting the button in my pocket, but it did it again last night while it was just sitting on the table.

alts.text: Ugh, my volume keeps dropping to zero by itself. I figured I was bumping the button in my pocket, but it did it again last night just lying on the table.
My phone repeatedly lowers the volume completely on its own. I assumed I was pressing the button while it was in my pocket, but it happened again last night while it was simply resting on the table.

sentences.note: **all the way down** 은 끝까지 줄였다는 뜻입니다. **on its own** 은 저절로, 혼자서라는 말입니다. **just sitting on the table** 은 탁자 위에 그냥 놓여 있었다는 뜻으로, 물건에도 sitting 을 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 이렇게 보니까 진짜 반갑다! 어머님은 좀 어떠셔? 지난번에 얘기했을 때 막 퇴원하셨다고 했잖아. 전화해야지 해야지 하면서 결국 못 했네.
sentences.text: It's so good to see you! How's your mom doing? Last time we talked she'd just gotten out of the hospital, and I kept meaning to call you, but I never did.

alts.text: Oh my gosh, hi! How's your mom? Last we talked she'd just gotten out of the hospital, and I kept meaning to call, but I never got around to it.
It is wonderful to see you! How is your mother doing? When we last spoke, she had just been discharged from the hospital, and I had intended to call you, but I never did.

sentences.note: **kept meaning to** 는 하려고 계속 마음만 먹었다는 뜻으로, 뒤에 but I never did 가 붙으면 결국 못 했다는 말이 됩니다. casual 의 **never got around to it** 은 짬을 못 내서 끝내 못 했다는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 4번 casual 의 turning itself all the way down 은 폰 자체를 줄인다는 말이 되어 뜻이 어긋남. 볼륨이 저절로 0으로 떨어진다는 말로 고치고 뒷부분도 더 짧은 구어로 줄임
3번 formal 의 selects reply all 은 원어민이 안 쓰는 말이라 uses reply all 로 고침
2번 formal 의 wished to know 는 지나치게 문어체라 wanted to know 로 고침
